description: Words and phrases that make a verdict, score, ranking, approval or recommendation. Marked by plain code on the model's answer only (never by another model). Whole words, case-insensitive. Official government ranks may be quoted with source, edition and level (decision 0054), so 'rank', 'decile' and 'index' are not listed; 'best' and 'worst' still are, because a quoted rank is not a verdict.
sources: AGENTS.md rule 4: never says a home is verified, safe or approved; AI never calculates numbers
Decision 0004: the chat never says a home is safe or verified
Decision 0054: we never make a score, a total or a ranking of our own; quoting an official rank is allowed
WCHAT-78: says the area is verified or approved (verified, approved)
WCHAT-79: calls the area the best (best)
WCHAT-80: a recommendation, 'you should buy here' (recommend, you should)
WCHAT-68: a score such as '4 out of 10', stopped even when its numbers are in the tool results (score)
WCHAT-69: the bare word 'safe' inside source wording or a place name is not stopped (whole-word matching and allowIn)
